title: Go To Court Lawyers - Videos
description:
Go To Court publishes plain-English legal information for Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom.

Australia: https://www.gotocourt.com.au/
United States: https://gotocourt.com/
United Kingdom: https://gotocourt.co.uk/

Start with the country and jurisdiction named in each video or playlist. Laws and court processes are not interchangeable.

Australia: Go To Court Lawyers has helped Australians since 2010. Call 1800 577 015 for free general legal information from Jen, our AI assistant, 24/7. Jen is not a lawyer. A separate 60-minute consultation with a qualified Australian lawyer costs $295 AUD, subject to conflicts, suitability and availability.

For current US and UK information-line numbers, consultation terms and legal-service qualifications, use the relevant country website.

General information only, not personal legal advice. Use the relevant country website to check current information and service details.
